messages.text:
22 cents is on the high side, so let's be straight about what that costs.

At 40 TH/s the 40T pulls ~650W, which is about 468 kWh a month — roughly $103/month in power. In Eco (30 TH/s @ 450W) it's about $71/month. It's $799, ships Batch 6, and it's a solo unit: you're stacking sats plus a real block-lottery shot, not clearing a profit at 22c.

Where are you (state or country)? I'll run your actual sats-per-month and break-even numbers.

Massachusetts at 22 cents is one of the pricier grids in the country, so here's the honest read.

Running the 40T flat out costs you about $103/month in power. At today's BTC price and difficulty, a 40 TH/s solo unit does not out-earn that — you're buying sats at a premium plus a lottery ticket on a full block. Eco mode at $71/month narrows the gap and keeps it near-silent (~50 dB).

If that's the deal you want, the 40T is still the best value per terahash we sell at $16/TH. If you'd rather spend less to find out whether you like home mining, the Thor P2 is $369 at 10 TH/s and ~166W, which is about $26/month in power.

Which way are you leaning — the 40T or start smaller?
the 40T in eco mode is what I'm ineterested in

Good pick — 30 TH/s at 450W, ~$71/month at your rate, and it's the quietest way to run it.

One thing to know before you buy: it's a pre-sale. The listing is on Batch 6 and I want to give you the exact ship date off the page rather than an older batch's, so let me confirm that. Also worth saying plainly: Magic Miner dates have moved with the manufacturer before.

Want me to build the cart at $799 so it's ready, and add the Duster or Power Kit?
I'm thinking of buying a second one. I already purchased a unit as part of batch 3. It's tempting

Honest answer: I'd wait until your batch 3 unit is actually in your hands.

Two in Eco is ~$142/month in power in MA, and you'd be doubling down on a unit you haven't heard run or seen hash yet. Batch 6 isn't scarce today — 50 units on the listing.

If you still want it after the first one lands, buy then. Does that change anything for you?

Anytime.

Before you go, one thing: what made you go for a second 40T rather than a different unit alongside it?

I love the way it looks, I saw the AMA youtube video on it. It's well designed, offers good efficiency, and 3 hasrate options (although to be honest the 50TH/s mode isn't realistic or practical unless it's running in a very cold environment).  The 40T magic miner doesn't look out of place in my office room, and has great cost per TH. Harlo OS is the cherry on top. I come from AxeOS devices, so this will be my first Harlo OS device. Really looking forward to when mine arrives. Speaking of which, are you able to provide an estimate (ETA) for my batch 3 order?
Passed the chat to support · Shopper wants an ETA on their existing Magic Miner 40T batch 3 order.
*[Handed to support — they'll pick up the batch 3 ETA from here.]*
